title: hubModuleData
responsibility: Load and verify sealed metadata for one authenticated project revision, and reject incomplete metadata before hosted reads.

inputs.name: hubModuleData.context
inputs.description: Authenticated repository, exact source revision, notes and evidence identities.

inputs.name: hubModuleData.admit
inputs.description: Whether to reject missing module metadata after verifying snapshot integrity.

inputs.name: hubRequiresModuleData.context
inputs.description: Selected revision entries used to determine whether the validation protocol is adopted.

outputs.name: hubModuleData
outputs.description: Committed metadata bound to the requested source revision and current evidence inputs.

outputs.name: hubRequiresModuleData
outputs.description: True when the selected source declares required metadata admission.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Missing, malformed, stale or incomplete committed module metadata; no alternate project or revision is substituted.
